comment: No family is set on any jack: nothing passes through them in Rack, so no colour can be right. The direction is reversed from what a Rack user expects, because the names come from the hardware: the eight jacks named Out1 to Out8 are Rack inputs, since a cable goes into them to say what feeds that hardware output, and the eight named In1 to In6 and GateIn1 to GateIn2 are Rack outputs. The mapping machinery is at hub_module.hh:133-175, which writes the hub knob's value into every parameter it is mapped to.
